scripts.sync: npm run design && npm run voiceconfig && cap sync
scripts.design: rm -rf demo/design && mkdir demo/design && cp -R design/tokens.css design/gui-tokens.css design/fonts demo/design/
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.voiceconfig: node -e "const e = process.env; require('fs').writeFileSync('demo/js/voice-config.js', '// Generated by npm run voiceconfig. Do not commit.\nwindow.AFFERENT_VOICE = ' + JSON.stringify({ url: e.VOICE_RELAY_URL || '', code: e.VOICE_RELAY_CODE || '' }) + ';\n')"
